## Scoped partial result

For 10000062 / AMR-099-0062, an explicit specialization of the prior Frettlöh–Garber layered triangular family has congruent complete vertex-centered closed metric balls of radius sqrt(10), all triangle diameters at most sqrt(10), and a non-cocompact Euclidean symmetry group.

The translation subgroup is exactly 2Z x {0}, so a horizontal period remains. The original source leaves “periodic” undefined and also mentions hyperbolic geometry. Consequently this refutes only the Euclidean cocompact/crystallographic interpretation. The full source remains unresolved, the hyperbolic clause is untreated, and historical novelty of the metric specialization is not established.

The proof includes all clipped edge and face pieces, including singleton boundary traces and their incidences. It does not substitute a vertex-star or corona check for the full metric-ball hypothesis.

## Independent adversarial review

A separate reviewer returned PASS for the exact frozen scoped proof, with no mandatory mathematical correction. The reviewer checked the original source, prior family, cap-shielding inequalities, congruence maps, and full symmetry group. All 16 submitted rooted cases passed; an independent standard-library checker passed 212 assertions over 64 rooted cases. The complete report is in `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10000062/review/REVIEW.md`.

## Validation

- `python3 unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10000062/verify.py`
- `python3 unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10000062/review/independent_checks.py`
- Both use only Python's standard library and exact rational arithmetic
- Original proof SHA-256 remains `3df33716dab169f07c9ff24434023d2945fc8121e03519f91a0a3fdb1ea30f84`

Only this problem's attempt folder changes. One substantive scoped proof attempt was used. This PR remains a draft for human review; no merge or release is requested.
title: Partial 10000062: metric-ball homogeneous Euclidean triangulation
